Safari Web Extension: a Pali dictionary for web pages.

Setup:
1. Open the app, click "Open Safari Settings…".
2. Tick "Dhamma.gift Search and Word Lookup" in the list on the left.
3. Click "Edit Websites…", set "When visiting other websites" to Allow.

Test on https://dhamma.gift/mn1

Mode 1 (default): right-click menu
Select a word, right-click, choose "Dhamma.gift". The dictionary popup opens.

Mode 2: click any word
Click the Dhamma.gift button in the Safari toolbar (or press Option+Shift+X). Now clicking any word opens the dictionary popup. Click the button again to turn it off.
